en.name: Hairtail
en.summary: Hairtail is the long silver ribbon of a fish sold in cut sections, oily and dark-fleshed under the shine. Fresh it keeps 1–2 days in the fridge and 2–3 months in the freezer, and it needs chilling fast for reasons beyond freshness.
en.pantry: Hairtail should never sit at ambient temperature, which is unfortunately how it is often displayed in Taiwanese markets. It is an oily, dark-fleshed fish, and that family is the one associated with histamine poisoning: chilled fish should be kept at 4 °C (40 °F) or below right along the supply chain and chilled rapidly after purchase. Histamine, once it has formed in a warm fish, survives cooking and freezing. Take a cool bag, buy from a stall that keeps its fish on ice, and follow the 2-hour rule, or 1 hour above 32 °C (90 °F).
en.fridge: Buy it already cut into sections and gutted, and hold it at 4 °C (40 °F) or below on ice, in a container that catches the melt water, cooking it within 1–2 days. Lay the sections in a single layer rather than piling them up. The silver guanine layer on the skin is delicate and flakes off with handling — it is edible and adds to the look of the finished dish, so handle the sections as little as you can. Store on the bottom shelf, below anything ready to eat.
en.freezer: Hairtail keeps 2–3 months at −18 °C (0 °F) — a short window, as for any oily fish, because the fat oxidises first. Freeze the sections in a single layer on a tray so the silver skin does not stick and tear, then bag them flat with the air pressed out, or ice-glaze them first. Frozen food stays safe indefinitely at −18 °C; the months are about quality. Freezing does nothing about histamine that formed before the fish went into the freezer.
en.thawing: Thaw in the fridge overnight on a plate, or in a sealed bag under cold running water. Never on the counter or in warm water. Pat dry, cook promptly, and do not refreeze raw fish.
spoilage: A sour or ammoniacal smell instead of a clean sea one.
The silver layer gone dull, yellow or patchy over most of the fish.
Flesh that stays dented when pressed rather than springing back.
A rancid, paint-like smell, or a brown cast to the dark flesh along the spine.
tips: Buy from a stall that keeps its fish on ice, not on an open tray.
Ask for it cut into sections and gutted at the stall.
Freeze in a single layer first so the silver skin does not tear.
Pat the sections dry before frying; wet hairtail spits and sticks.

faq.q: How long does hairtail keep in the fridge?
faq.a: 1–2 days at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, gutted, cut into sections and kept on ice.
Yes, 2–3 months at −18 °C. Freeze it in a single layer first so the silver skin stays intact.

faq.q: Should you scrape off the silver skin?
faq.a: No need. The silver guanine layer is edible and part of the look. It flakes off with handling, so handle the fish gently.

faq.q: Why does hairtail need chilling so quickly?
faq.a: It is an oily, dark-fleshed fish, the family associated with histamine poisoning. Histamine formed in a warm fish survives cooking and freezing, so rapid chilling is the control.

zh.name: 白帶魚
zh.summary: 白帶魚是那條銀亮的長帶狀魚，通常切段販售，銀皮底下是含油的暗色肉。新鮮的冷藏可放 1～2 天，冷凍 2～3 個月；而它需要盡快降溫的理由，不只是新鮮度。
zh.pantry: 白帶魚絕不該放在常溫，偏偏台灣市場很常這樣陳列。它是含油的暗色肉魚種，而這一類正是與組織胺中毒相關的家族：冷藏魚應在整條供應鏈上都維持 4 °C 以下，買回來後也要迅速降溫。組織胺一旦在溫暖的魚體中生成，加熱和冷凍都消不掉。請帶保冷袋、向有鋪冰的攤商購買，並守 2 小時原則，室溫超過 32 °C 時為 1 小時。
zh.fridge: 請買已經切段、去內臟的，鋪冰放 4 °C 以下，容器要能接住融水，並在 1～2 天內煮掉。魚段單層平放，不要疊高。魚皮上那層銀色的鳥糞嘌呤很脆弱，一翻動就會剝落——它可以吃，也是成品好看的關鍵，所以盡量少動它。放最下層，位置低於所有即食食品。
zh.freezer: 白帶魚在 −18 °C 下可放 2～3 個月——和所有油脂魚一樣是短區間，因為最先變質的是脂肪。魚段先單層排在盤上冷凍，銀皮才不會沾黏撕破，凍硬後再壓平裝袋、擠出空氣，或先做冰鍍。−18 °C 下安全性是無限期的，月數講的是品質。冷凍對「進冷凍庫之前就生成的組織胺」毫無作用。
zh.thawing: 放盤子上冷藏隔夜解凍，或密封裝袋用冷水沖。不要放室溫或泡溫水。擦乾後盡快烹調，生魚不要再次冷凍。
spoilage: 聞起來發酸或有氨味，而不是乾淨的海味。
大面積銀色變得黯淡、泛黃或斑駁脫落。
按壓後凹陷回不來，而不是有彈性。
出現油耗、油漆般的氣味，或脊骨邊暗色肉轉褐。
tips: 向有鋪冰的攤商購買，不要買敞開托盤上的。
請攤商當場切段、去內臟。
先單層冷凍，銀皮才不會撕破。
下鍋前擦乾；濕的白帶魚會噴油又黏鍋。

faq.q: 白帶魚冷藏可以放多久？
faq.a: 去內臟切段、鋪冰放 4 °C 以下，1～2 天。
可以，−18 °C 下 2～3 個月。先單層冷凍，銀皮才能保持完整。
不用。那層銀色可以吃，也是賣相的一部分。它一翻動就會剝落，所以動作輕一點。

faq.q: 白帶魚為什麼要盡快降溫？
faq.a: 它是含油的暗色肉魚，屬於與組織胺中毒相關的家族。溫暖魚體中生成的組織胺耐得住加熱和冷凍，所以迅速降溫就是控制手段。
